02e848cadb0b17d1f63b3b73e3ac8c31e9c9581e.text: Draw a line under each cheekbone, then blend it upwards. Tip: Soften the line with a sponge.

03040318da061ce70ae71ef247ee45d247991bff.text: Trace the edge of your lips with the pencil. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

03994f053e8b6858f1b4fcf190dca1f538302bae.text: Draw a thin, sharp line along your upper lashes. Tip: Short strokes, then join them.

04109f2d17dc18bf054a71404b4a9740911db07a.text: Tap a little highlighter on top of each cheekbone. Why this is easier: One fingertip, a few taps, and it melts in. Tip: Keep it on the cheekbone, away from your eyes.

09ab801838fe66074f6ffeacecb600bc7151d5cd.text: Dab concealer under each eye with the wand, then blend. Why this is easier: Small dabs that you blend with a fingertip afterwards. Tip: Anchor your little finger on your cheek.

0c6e2bf9c0722c504c7e4aefab95aad81a06bac3.text: Tap Take the photo when you're ready

0e37fd07bdafbc813be96588a75acbdb0e9bc81f.text: Optional. Skip it on shaky days. Glue the strip, wait, then press it onto your lash line. Tip: A helper can put them on for you.

0e478211d2a16168d4f889c4207129c83dc993af.text: Press the puff into the powder, then onto your face. Why this is easier: Big soft presses with no aim needed. Tip: Set the compact on the table, not in your hand.

10842836c6ed58cc16980eafedbd3eefc247cb7a.text: Press the stamp on the front of each brow, then lift. Why this is easier: One press makes the shape. Lining it up is the only careful part. Tip: Line it up in the mirror before you press.

14e1f6fd4ef609fdb6a15011a16cf0b9d6324259.text: Pat colour on the lid. Smudge a deeper shade along the lashes. Why this is easier: Smudging is meant to look soft, so a wobble just adds to it. Tip: Use a fingertip or a small flat brush.

197d285c9b3d27459e43382e73d99dfc0969c60e.text: Got it. Your eyes looked a little closed, so the preview may show softer liner.

1c11328e488a58430d2dae4ceafbefe2669e4f44.text: Draw one thin line along your upper lashes. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

21e99aad10d70c8ed5efb8043b2283a5f751d5f8.text: Clamp the curler at the lash roots and hold for five seconds. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

220441df22126b4d71bc52070665c23afd55cc06.text: Tip the wand and touch it lightly to your lower lashes. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

2d9ce23354a521f581f9cd31954ac619b37145cb.text: Pump a little onto your fingers and smooth it over your face. Why this is easier: A pump, your fingers and a sheer tint. Nothing to aim and nothing to twist. Tip: Press the pump with your palm, not a fingertip.

30ebfeee12610a20b1e4108dd5cc3025363a5cd8.text: Choose an old photo of you wearing the look.

3c99f095b53a654013cc853c7a1f09918a73f955.text: Swirl the big brush in powder and buff over your face. Why this is easier: A short, fat brush sits in your palm. Big circles, no aim. Tip: Tip a little powder into the lid first.

45d673c070ecb727e135518b2f59990c7802dd98.text: Try a photo of just you

484754c425e5db55681f7c66da68909c45d4ed2a.text: Optional. Skip it on shaky days. Tip the wand and touch it lightly to your lower lashes. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

4867c06d64ecc85a17559edfa5082af62ddebe31.text: We couldn't find a face in that photo. Please choose another.

499e9c167e3226e5c1d6dcbe2cb8c7c9b69e5da6.text: Swipe the gloss wand across your lips. Why this is easier: Gloss is forgiving. A wobble just looks shiny. Tip: Dab it on with a fingertip if the wand is fiddly.

4a9d64dea5da95e6eae94a86d4e294f328f11daa.text: Flick the fan brush along the top of your cheekbones. Why this is easier: A soft sweep where the light hits. Tip: Keep it on the cheekbone, away from your eyes.

4cc8c5b91e3bb7e275379e3c20a91344401da9af.text: Dab blush on your cheeks with two fingers, then blend. Why this is easier: Your fingers do the work, and cream blends away any wobble. Tip: Smile, then dab on the round part of your cheeks.

4e5e0d7f56d34c8255f5534cc1b0be62e0cf1238.text: Close your eyes and mist your face from arm's length. Why this is easier: One press and your makeup lasts longer, so there is less to redo later. Tip: Check the pump is light enough to press. Some are stiff.

506acccdfb2036cc3341716755a6c8dcbd5c1f88.text: Draw a line along your lashes and flick a wing out. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

58e71d14a3f389fa43660f5d7a2c81fc1563aa38.text: Swipe the stick on your cheeks, then bounce a sponge over it. Why this is easier: No line to draw. A sponge is easy to grip and blends it soft. Tip: Hold the sponge in your fist.

6243c13858681ac92b93620c8cca6a524857a0e2.text: Brush the gel up through each brow in one sweep. Why this is easier: It follows the brows you already have. One sweep, no lines to draw. Tip: Brush up, then out.

65a13b02b5a0164e4b209f20836bdd5afc49c28c.text: Press dark shadow along your lashes with a damp flat brush. Why this is easier: You press instead of drawing, and shadow stays soft and easy to tidy. Tip: Press, lift, move along. Don't drag.

6622e143318fe479383f12ca8eeb1ec75c0e47b7.text: Draw small hair strokes along each brow with the pencil. Tip: Rest your elbow and anchor your little finger.

74e60f8fd864676f1e7feebc85a040b01517b27d.text: Dot foundation on your face, then buff it in with a brush. Why this is easier: Big, slow strokes with lots of room for error. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

7686b8e131b00fd6fb366de494ac7ff84f563bc8.text: Sweep bronzer where the sun would hit your face. Why this is easier: A big brush covers a big area. There is nothing to aim at. Tip: Choose a brush with a thick handle.

7a304b0a047c672171274c47c859d3720ba6c500.text: Dot the stick under each eye and pat it in. Why this is easier: A chunky stick you can hold in your fist. Patting with a finger hides wobbles. Tip: Hold the stick in your fist like a big pen.

7bd652361281e3d4b14c017ba5d65f1a68fc6c93.text: Carve the crease with a deep shade, then fill the lid. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

852e19f064eb711dd4e9883c8a2e9970a13aaf62.text: Twist up the lipstick and trace it over your lips. Tip: Tap it on with a fingertip instead of tracing the edge.

8a165cdb8b752f1b5e0e53eec826a6c6e359949f.text: Choose an old photo of them wearing the look.

9ead64e7ddaa0b16dfac247339a2fe3ee6352929.text: Run the pencil along your upper waterline, under the lashes. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

a0f16e45348f892489e40c65c2d9380681b55481.text: Dip a cotton bud in micellar water and wipe away smudges. Why this is easier: Any slip can come off. Knowing that makes every other step calmer. Tip: Pour a little micellar water into the cap first.

a1b6a713b3666e627a2eb1c75ef52f58fcd9c87d.text: Wiggle the wand at the lash roots, then pull it up. Why this is easier: There is no truly easy version of mascara. These tips make it calmer. Tip: Hold the wand in your fist with a ring or knob grip.

aed11e483a155475e102f49c7a204a25c8ae5fc3.text: Press powder into each brow with the angled brush. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

b38da4269bbce08059cd6223678542dc871c8788.text: Dab short strokes along your lashes, then smudge them together. Why this is easier: Short dabs are easier than one long line, and smudging hides any wobble. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table and your little finger on your cheek.

c45aa696cac2da7478c2a00a35154dffbc515084.text: Paint a line along your upper lashes with the fine brush. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

c8ef72b28e7ff473e0b0e7703279cd284f916f57.text: Optional. Skip it on shaky days. Clamp the curler at the lash roots and hold for five seconds. Tip: Rest your elbow on the table.

c9a6edb41b2e1bcd63906e4c0b3e6459493f6d22.text: Swipe the stick on your lid, then pat it in. Why this is easier: One colour and one fingertip. Cream blends itself, so edges don't matter. Tip: Close your eye and press gently.
